name: mobile-2k
description: Hypothetical mobile NPU sized from public data on the Ethos-U85 top configuration (Arm product brief and announcement: 2048 MACs/cycle, 4 TOP/s at 1 GHz, up to 267 KB internal SRAM, up to six 128-bit AXI5). 32x64 output-stationary array: 2048 MAC/cycle, 4.096 TOP/s at 1 GHz and 2 ops/MAC. SRAM 267 KiB. Every tensor in DRAM; memory system from Vela 5.2.0 Ethos_U85_SYS_DRAM_High: its two 128-bit DRAM ports modeled as one 256-bit port; DRAM 24 B/cycle (16 B x 2 ports x 0.75 clock scale = 24 GB/s at 1 GHz); 500-cycle read and 250-cycle write latency; 64 reads and 32 writes outstanding. Bursts up to 8 beats, the shortest power of two with which 64 outstanding reads cover 500 cycles. Tiles 64x64x256: the largest power-of-two square tile, a multiple of the array, whose two slots of two panel buffers fit with panels at least 128 B deep (Vela Dram_burst_length); the 100864 B left over is the weight cache. Depthwise datapath 192 MAC/cycle, the 3x3 rate of the Ethos-U85-2048 performance model in Vela 5.2.0's Regor: its 8-bit depthwise runs on the 4x4x16 output microblock only, 4 kernel taps per 4-cycle step, so 9 taps take 3 steps (256 MAC/cycle peak, three quarters of it for 3x3). Pipeline 4 cycles per panel, the simulator default.
